input: How long is the warranty on the ES-200?

meta.note: claude-haiku-5-5, one trial, run by OpsDesk

output:
Hi! The ES-200 is Brightside-branded equipment, so it carries a 2 year warranty covering parts and labor from the delivery date.

One condition to be aware of: the ES-200 manual recommends water between 50 and 100 ppm hardness. Hard water causes scale buildup and voids the warranty, so please keep your water within that range.

If you have any other questions, just let us know!
